looking.text: I’m looking for a black oversized hoodie, under eighty dollars.

found.text: Fynd finds matching products from different retailers.

open.text: And I can open the product directly at the retailer.

different.text: Something completely different works the same way.

specific.text: Even something specific that’s hard to find.

particular.text: Or the exact style and color I have in mind.

close.text: No more searching store after store. Describe it, and Fynd finds it.
